decisions.reason: The ERP interface plugin took the most development effort and is central to the firm's announced multichannel integration direction, so management will keep investing in it rather than write it off.

As the last surviving price comparison tracking plugin, it now carries the remaining sunk cost and justification for that line, so management keeps it, though its absence from the website since 2020 raises the risk of withdrawal.

The net price reporting plugin still fits the firm's analytics focus and represents committed development effort, so management keeps it despite the withdrawal of its companion net price display plugin.
